gui.startNote:
After clicking the **Start** button then a **separate browser window** will show a fresh **Weverse page**.
**Login** to **Weverse** there **once**. *For Your Information if you are using Google login, the browser might close by itself then reopen by itself. Then you have to try login again until success*.
After **login success** make sure you are in the **Home page**, **don't close it** then **come back here**.
